name: Erika Doreze
source:
She is the older of the twin sisters of the Dreze family. She has blond hair and blue eyes, inherited from her father, and a doll-like figure with thin arms and legs.

She has a strong leadership ability and serves as a member of the Discipline Committee at the school. She is highly respected by teachers and students.

She is aware of her uniquely Japanese good looks and is a bit snobbish about them.
